title: Preserve score and track multirest preferences
scope: Retain BinaryStylesheet multiple-bar-rest settings with independent global and per-track scope.
acceptance: Use a global preference and two conflicting track overrides without changing the actual measure sequence.
Cover explicit false, true and absence and document precedence.
Pinned AlphaTab retains the same preferences after GP8 export.
exclusions: Collapsing measures visually is the renderer responsibility.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Reproduced at stylesheet.perTrackMultiBarRest. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.
Hash-bound source, actual strict exports, exact view bytes and final pinned consumer preferences with notation/measure facts.

resolution: Implemented independent optional global and single-track multi-rest preferences through their actual PartConfiguration mapping. False/true values preserve exact preferences; absent requests default to false and materialize explicit view bytes. Measures and notation remain unchanged. Awaiting different-agent final-commit acceptance review and root combined gates.
verification: Focused public tests, all 27 raw consumer combinations and pinned GP7 grand-staff source pass.
Four-measure source retains two rest measures and surrounding notes at every staff.
Semantic inventory adds two fields and two binary wire leaves; no enum or dispatch is introduced.
Corpus accounting refreshed. Full conformance, capability probe and prek remain assigned to root.
